schemes.name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi Yojana
schemes.benefit: ₹6,000 per year directly transferred to bank accounts in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 every 4 months.
schemes.eligibility: All landholding farmer families having cultivable land in their names (subject to exclusion criteria like institutional landholders/income tax payees).
schemes.documents: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership papers (Khata/Khasra/Khatauni), Bank passbook linked with Aadhaar.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply online at pmkisan.gov.in portal or visit nearest Common Service Center (CSC). e-KYC can be done via Aadhaar OTP or facial recognition on PM-KISAN App.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
schemes.benefit: Comprehensive insurance coverage against loss of crops from pre-sowing to post-harvest due to non-preventable natural risks (drought, flood, unseasonal rain, pests). Farmers pay minimal premium: 2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops.
schemes.eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas.
schemes.documents: Land Record copy, Sowing Certificate / Patwari report, Aadhaar Card, Bank account details.
schemes.how_to_apply: Enroll through bank branch, PMFBY online portal, CSC, or designated insurance company agent within crop cut-off date.

schemes.name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Scheme
schemes.benefit: Short-term credit up to ₹3,00,000 at a subsidized interest rate of 4% per annum (with prompt repayment incentive of 3% subvention). Collateral-free loan up to ₹1.60 Lakh.
schemes.eligibility: Individual/joint farmers, owner cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, sharecroppers, and SHGs/JLGs.
schemes.documents: Application form, Identity and address proof (Aadhaar/Voter ID), Land records & crop sowing details.
schemes.how_to_apply: Submit single-page KCC application to any rural/commercial bank or online via farmer portal.

schemes.name: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana (Per Drop More Crop)
schemes.hindi_name: प्रधानमंत्री कृषि सिंचाई योजना (ड्रिप एवं स्प्रिंकलर सब्सिडी)
schemes.benefit: 45% to 55% government subsidy on installation of Drip and Sprinkler irrigation systems for precision water usage.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers of all categories having cultivable land and an assured water source.
schemes.documents: Land document (7/12 extract / RTC), Aadhaar Card, Water source certificate, Bank details.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through State Department of Agriculture / Horticulture online portal or District Horticulture Office.

schemes.name: Soil Health Card Scheme
schemes.benefit: Free soil test report issued every 3 years containing status of 12 nutrients (N, P, K, S, Zn, Fe, Cu, Mn, Bo, pH, EC, OC) and crop-wise dosage recommendations.
schemes.documents: Farmer identity and agricultural field sample collected by agricultural department or submitted by farmer.
schemes.how_to_apply: Contact Village Agriculture Extension Officer (Gram Sevak) or state Krishi Vigyan Kendra (KVK).

schemes.name: PM-KUSUM (Solar Agricultural Pumps)
schemes.benefit: Up to 60% subsidy on installation of stand-alone solar agricultural water pumps (up to 7.5 HP) and grid-connected solar power plants on barren land.
schemes.eligibility: Individual farmers, groups of farmers, FPOs, Cooperatives and Water User Associations.
schemes.documents: Aadhaar Card, Land ownership document, Bank passbook, NOC from electricity board if grid pump.
schemes.how_to_apply: Apply through State Renewable Energy Development Agency (e.g. UPNEDA, MEDA, HAREDA) web portal.

schemes.name: National Agriculture Market (e-NAM)
schemes.benefit: Pan-India electronic trading portal networking existing APMC mandis to create a unified national market for agricultural commodities with transparent online bidding and digital payment.
schemes.eligibility: Farmers, traders, commission agents, and Farmer Producer Organizations (FPOs).
schemes.documents: Aadhaar Card, Bank passbook, APMC registration details (if trader).
schemes.how_to_apply: Register online at enam.gov.in or directly at the e-NAM kiosk in your registered APMC market yard.
